text: 10 OVERDOSAGE There is no specific information on the treatment of overdosage with aprepitant. In the event of overdose, CINVANTI should be discontinued and general supportive treatment and monitoring should be provided. Because of the antiemetic activity of CINVANTI, drug-induced emesis may not be effective in cases of CINVANTI overdosage. Aprepitant is not removed by hemodialysis.

10 OVERDOSAGE Headache, fatigue, and dizziness were reported in healthy subjects receiving a single dose of 100 or 130 mg aprepitant injectable emulsion (3.1 to 4 times the recommended dose). Drowsiness and headache were reported in one patient who ingested 1440 mg of oral aprepitant. In the event of overdose, general supportive treatment and monitoring should be provided. Aprepitant is not removed by hemodialysis.
